🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* SEBI and RBI \(India\)
• *Announcement:* India's securities regulator SEBI, alongside the RBI, has launched "Demat 2\.0"\. This pilot program aims to tokenize the nation's \$620 billion corporate bond market, allowing for the issuance and settlement of corporate bonds as digital tokens\.
• *Market Stance:* 🟢 BULLISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(90\% \- This is an official pilot program launched by key financial regulatory bodies in India\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* None
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* Infrastructure
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Inflows \(Modernization of India's capital markets and improved efficiency in bond issuance/settlement are likely to attract FIIs seeking advanced financial infrastructure\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should consider overweighting Indian companies with strong balance sheets and those active in infrastructure projects, as easier access to corporate bond financing could lower their cost of capital and boost expansion prospects\.
